message:
Let me look at the DNS dictionary to understand the structure of the DNS packet attributes:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server -name "*.dict" | xargs grep -l "dns" 2>/dev/null | head -10 && echo "---" && find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/freeradius-server -path "*dns*" -name "*.dict" -o -path "*dns*" -name "*.attrs" | head</｜｜DSML｜｜>
